channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Canada Imposes New Tariffs on U.S. Goods, as Trade War Intensifies
item.description: The duties are a retaliation against President Trump’s recent tariffs, raising concerns about further escalation.

item.title: NPR: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
item.description: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

item.title: BBC News: Harry and Meghan 'surprised' by King's letter making clear they remain non-working royals
item.description: A spokesman says they were not told in advance about the letter sent on behalf of the king, although palace sources deny this.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I suggested maybe a lighter touch’: William Shatner on Star Trek at 60
item.description: The actor and others involved with the phenomenon speak about the legacy and progressivism of a much-loved science fiction TV series as it reaches an important milestone ‘The mystery of time,” muses William Shatner , and…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Video: Saudi–Russia Press Conference in Moscow: Key Takeaways
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister is in Moscow for a joint Saudi Russian press conference.

item.title: Ars Technica: The complex corporate web behind a $3.2 billion AI data center
item.description: When multiple companies are behind one project, who bears responsibility for problems?

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How NASA Testing Changed US Food Inspection Forever
item.description: In the early 20th century, public outcry following Upton Sinclair’s The Jungle led to stricter food safety protocols. NASA took them a step further.

item.title: WIRED Science: Two of the Universe's Great Mysteries May Have Their Own Dimension
item.description: Dark energy might be getting weaker. Scientists are wondering if interactions with dark matter in a “dark dimension” may be responsible.

item.title: WIRED Business: Who Cares if AI Is Conscious—It’s Basically Alive
item.description: While philosophers ponder AI consciousness, the models have ideas of their own.

item.title: The New Yorker: Tom Sachs Channels Chanel
item.description: At his downtown studio, the perennially provocative artist makes a lo-fi version of the brand’s flagship Parisian store.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Cleo Camp Created the Reversible Tee Everybody Wants
item.description: The Los Angeles-based designer spends her free time making fish sculptures and going phone-free in Maine.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: George Rouy Makes a Bigger Splash
item.description: The British “It” boy edging the art world debuts on the megagallery main stage.
